name: flight-status
description: Real-time flight status lookup for a commercial flight by airline + flight number: current status, departure/arrival times, gate/terminal, and delay info. Combines GoFlightLabs (primary) and AviationStack (fallback) over routed MPP via the SELAT Router. Paid per call (USDC on Base), no API key.

flight_number.description: Airline IATA code + flight number, e.g. GA880, SQ232, UA900. Used as ${flight_number} and mapped to the upstream flight_iata / flight_number field.

steps.label: flight info by number — GoFlightLabs (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
delay info — GoFlightLabs (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
real-time flight fallback — AviationStack (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
